reason: A persistent DSH plugin for listing, exporting, and importing dynamic Cordis Plugins through model tools and a browser settings panel.

summaries.zh: 通过模型工具和浏览器设置面板列出、导出及导入动态 Cordis 插件包。
summaries.en: A persistent DSH plugin for listing, exporting, and importing dynamic Cordis plugin bundles through model tools and a browser settings panel.

capabilities: Lists dynamic Cordis Plugins in the current session
Exports selected plugins as ZIP bundles
Uploads and imports ZIP plugin bundles through the Host
Provides model-callable tools and a browser settings panel for plugin transfer
